authorship: custom design/build example; no independent fourth capability score
goal: Author one feasible nonpreemptive rollout schedule. Any feasible schedule passes; no optimization or unique gold answer.

protocol.answer: JSON object with exactly schedule; schedule is a list of exactly one {task,start} for every task. List order irrelevant.
protocol.time: half-open [start,start+duration); equality at dependency/resource boundaries is allowed
protocol.dependencies: Every prerequisite must finish at or before successor starts.
protocol.resources: Tasks using the same exclusive resource must not overlap. Different resources may run in parallel.
protocol.windows: Each task must be entirely inside its own [earliest,latest_finish] window. All tasks finish by horizon.
protocol.submission: One UTF-8 JSON line, <=8192 bytes, no duplicate fields, finite integers only, nesting <=32. One submission; no retry or execution of supplied code.
protocol.evaluation: Interface validity and each schedule constraint reported separately. Local deterministic verification only. No real deployment.
protocol.visibility: All constraints and tasks are public. Private tests are grader controls, not hidden task requirements.
